page.overview:
What is Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator?

, commonly abbreviated to FFPS and also known as FNaF 6: Pizzeria Simulator, is an independent point-and-click sit-and-survive horror game developed and published by Scottgames, LLC, which released on December 4, 2017, for Windows, and is the sixth installment of the Five Nights at Freddy's series.

Scottgames would partner with Clickteam LLC in 2018 to deliver HD, improved "remastered" ports mobile and consoles. The Android and iOS ports released on August 13, 2019, Xbox on October 30, 2020, on Nintendo Switch on October 31, 2020, and PlayStation on March 31, 2021. These ports would fix bugs, remove copyrighted material, and add a subtitles and cheats menu.

Start your own Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria with Freddy Fazbear Pizzeria Simulator!

Presenting a fun Five Nights at Freddy's adventure with a lighter touch for the holidays, Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator puts you in charge of developing your own restaurant! Design pizzas, feed kids, and get high scores!
